t: A Wi-Fi name badge with an E Ink screen and a Pico W inside.
steps: Look for Badger 2040 W at Pimoroni, The Pi Hut or PiShop.us. Stock is scarce, and the newer Badgeware Badger is its successor.
Connect it to your computer with a micro USB cable.
Try the built-in BadgerOS launcher and open the badge example.
Edit the badge text with your own name and save it.
Edit WIFI_CONFIG.py with your network details and run a Wi-Fi example.
Hold buttons A and C together to return to the launcher.
meta: Open Board. From $44.95. A few stores.
